svg.title: Interface do Player
svg.desc: Player de vídeo com overlay de controles, barra de progresso clicável, volume, fullscreen e auto-hide dos controles após inatividade. — Design System AUVP · tema claro

g.class: bg-card p-6 md:p-12 rounded-2xl border border-border flex flex-col gap-8 w-full
w-full aspect-video bg-black rounded-xl relative flex items-center justify-center group cursor-pointer overflow-hidden shadow-xl
absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent z-10 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300
w-16 h-16 bg-primary/90 backdrop-blur rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-primary-foreground transition-transform group-hover:scale-110 shadow-[0_0_30px_hsl(var(--primary)/0.3)] z-20
svg-content lucide lucide-play h-7 w-7 ml-1
absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full px-4 py-3 z-20 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 flex flex-col gap-2
w-full h-1 hover:h-2 bg-white/30 rounded-full cursor-pointer relative transition-all
absolute top-0 left-0 h-full bg-primary rounded-full w-[35%] relative
absolute right-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/2 w-3 h-3 bg-primary rounded-full shadow-md scale-0 group-hover:scale-100 transition-transform origin-center
w-0 overflow-hidden group-hover/vol:w-16 transition-all duration-300 h-1 bg-white/30 rounded-full cursor-pointer

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

g.class: text-xs font-bold text-accent uppercase tracking-[1px] mb-2 block bg-accent/10 w-fit px-2 py-1 rounded
text-foreground font-anek text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-4

text.tspan: A hierarquia de textos no player enfatiza o nome da aula.
Botões de ação como "Marcar como concluída" ou "Avaliar
aula" devem vir logo abaixo deste bloco.

g.class: bg-card border border-border text-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-anek font-bold text-[13px] uppercase transition-all flex items-center gap-2 w-fit shadow-sm
lucide lucide-circle-check-big h-4 w-4 text-accent mt-0.5 shrink-0
svg-content lucide lucide-circle-check-big h-4 w-4 text-accent mt-0.5 shrink-0

text.tspan: Auto-hide: Overlay e botões desaparecem após

g.class: lucide lucide-circle-check-big h-4 w-4 text-accent mt-0.5 shrink-0
svg-content lucide lucide-circle-check-big h-4 w-4 text-accent mt-0.5 shrink-0

text.tspan: Contraste: O vídeo sempre possui fundo preto e

g.class: lucide lucide-circle-check-big h-4 w-4 text-accent mt-0.5 shrink-0

text.tspan: Play State: O botão central deve ter backdrop-blur
